visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man wearing a white t-shirt and a blue cap walks toward a brightly lit arcade stall alongside a young girl with long dark hair. The stall is packed with large plush toys in various colors and multiple miniature basketball hoops arranged in a grid pattern. (2) The camera angle shifts to a closer perspective behind the man as he stands before the '9-grid' basketball game. He looks up at the hoops, preparing to throw, while the environment is filled with crowded shelves of prizes and artificial overhead lighting. (3) The man picks up a basketball and attempts to throw it toward the upper hoops. His movements are deliberate as he adjusts his posture to aim at the distant targets. The girl watches from the side, standing close to the counter. (4) The man continues his throwing attempts in quick succession. The ball is seen hitting the backboard or the rim and bouncing back. Nearby, another person in a black shirt is partially visible at a neighboring stall. The overall setting remains vibrant with dense object presence.
